purpose.primary: Estimate the out-of-sample performance of the nine candidates frozen by the amended Stage 7 reselection on five simulator-seed blocks not used by exploration, validation, or the inspected original final test.
purpose.secondary: Separate intervention effect from optimization gain by comparing every candidate with no intervention and a normally generated certainty=1.0, effectiveness=1.0 reference.
purpose.descriptive: Retain the spring 0.8,0.8 condition and the exact prior-study package as contextual comparisons without using either to select or rerank candidates.
purpose.amendment_status: The simple_max comparison and amended shortlist were defined after the original Stage 8 results were inspected. This retest therefore uses a new untouched simulator-seed group.
not_in_scope: selecting, tuning, dropping, or reranking candidates with revised final-test results
pooling network-specific candidates into a universal optimum
declaring one optimization method generally superior
introducing a post-hoc minimum important effect threshold
treating prior_high as reachable by changing certainty and effectiveness alone

objective.name: cumulative_selfish_fraction
objective.scope: Estimate effects separately for each network and each frozen candidate.

candidate_source.projection_policy: Copy all nine selected rows, retain the 30 fields needed for execution and comparison, and prefix 17 validation-result fields with stage7_ to distinguish them from revised final-test results.
candidate_source.policy: Evaluate all nine amended candidates without addition, removal, parameter modification, reranking, or reselection.

candidate_reporting_policy.selection_order_1: Candidate 1 was fixed by the amended validation rule before revised final testing and is used for the main network-specific candidate statement.
candidate_reporting_policy.selection_order_2_and_3: Candidates 2 and 3 are frozen representatives of different validation regions and are reported descriptively without replacing candidate 1.
candidate_reporting_policy.individual_selection_role: The qualified or exploratory scope is retained for each candidate instead of assuming one common qualification status within a network.
candidate_reporting_policy.facebook_limit: All three Facebook candidates are exploratory because no candidate satisfied the amended eligibility rule.
candidate_reporting_policy.ba1000_limit: BA1000 candidates 1 and 2 are qualified; candidate 3 is an exploratory representative added to preserve a third distinct region.
candidate_reporting_policy.test_result_policy: Report every candidate and never use revised final-test values or confidence intervals to rerank, replace, tune, or discard candidates.

fairness_rules: Evaluate every candidate and comparator on the same five simulator-seed blocks within each network.
Use the same 100 iterations, retained raw level, agent settings, information settings, timing, and initial-source settings for every condition.
Treat every candidate as network-specific and never apply it to another network.
Use the exact four-decimal certainty and effectiveness values frozen after amended Stage 7.
Generate candidate, simple_max, and legacy_balance opinions through the same design-variable path.
Use the exact existing opinion CSV only for prior_high and interpret it as an external package benchmark.
Do not inspect a partial result to alter remaining execution or reporting roles.

seed_policy.final_test_use_policy: Use the revised final-test seeds only after the amended candidate CSV is frozen. Never feed these results back into candidate selection or optimization.

interpretation.reduction: The absolute-suppression confidence interval is entirely above zero.
interpretation.reduction_tendency_with_uncertainty: The point estimate is positive but the confidence interval includes zero.
interpretation.increase: The absolute-suppression confidence interval is entirely below zero.
interpretation.no_clear_reduction: No clear directional conclusion is supported.

inference.multiplicity_policy: Do not convert the nine candidate comparisons into a new winner search. Candidate 1 in each network was fixed before revised testing; candidates 2 and 3 remain descriptive.
inference.policy: Report continuous estimates, seed-block directions, and confidence intervals without adding a post-hoc magnitude threshold.

interpretation_limits: Use candidate 1 for the main network-specific candidate statement and report candidates 2 and 3 descriptively.
Respect each candidate's qualified or exploratory selection role.
Treat simple_max as the direct benchmark for whether optimization improved on naively maximizing both design variables.
Treat prior_high as an external package benchmark whose base-rate settings differ from generated design-variable conditions.
Five revised final-test seed blocks do not establish validity outside the modeled networks and fixed intervention conditions.
